text_block_list.text: One day, while out shopping—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, what a terrible selection that shop 
had! Not a single thread matched the right 
color...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're from the Academy...! Perfect 
timing! Hey, do you know any other craft 
shops? Take me there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for thread to fix a fray in my 
hat... but nowhere has anything good!
choice_data_list: Ah, that precious hat of yours...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! The magical hat I got from 
Grandma! Come on, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nngh, just being black isn't good enough! 
It has to be a deep black imbued with 
magical power! Next!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No good! Grandma told me this brand wears 
out way too fast! On to the next one! 
Next!

—And so, after checking five more shops, 
we finally...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—This is the one! The color, the 
thickness, the material, everything is 
perfect! Phew~, I finally found it...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to mend it right away! I 
have to restore the hat's magical power as 
soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there a park around here? I'll do 
it there, take me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right...! Stitch by stitch, infusing 
my magical power...
(Stitch, stitch... Jab!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Ouuuch?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! This is nothing...! It doesn't 
even hurt anymore! Back to work, back to 
work...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah~~~! It's crooked again...! I've 
already resewn this ten times...!
choice_data_list: Why not ask someone good at sewing...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Only a witch or a magical girl can repair 
this! Grandma told me that a long time 
ago—

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
—Daddy! The ornament on my hat fell off! 
Fix it, pleeease~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Sweepy, go easy on him. Daddy 
has to get to work. Besides... Those 
without magical power cannot fix this hat.

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Really...?! Then, then... what 
should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandmother
text_block_list.text:
Why, you'll fix it yourself of course! 
Pouring your heart into it, stitch by 
stitch. This is also part of your training 
to become a witch—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—So I have to do it all by myself. No 
matter how hard it is.

...Her grandmother likely framed it that 
way so she would grow up able to solve 
problems with her own strength...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, of course she is! ...Anyway! I'll 
redo it as many times as it takes until it 
looks pretty...!

She prepared to return to her work. After 
hearing that story, I couldn't just step 
in and do it for her. Still, I wanted to 
help somehow...
choice_data_list:
Why not watch a video to learn sewing 
techniques?

Ah~ if only we could fix it fast with 
magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A video? Like on UmaTube? ...Hmph, is that 
actually gonna help?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let me see? Huh... that's surprisingly 
easy to follow. So I just need to do it 
like this... Hmm, hmm...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I-It's finished!! A flawless finish!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun~♪ In the hands of magical girl 
Sweepy, something like this is a piece of 
cake!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, you were actually pretty helpful, 
too, so as a reward, I'll cast a 'Good 
Fortune Spell' on you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here goes—!! 'Phalaenopsis Orchid☆'!

Her cheerful voice echoed high beneath the 
clear blue sky. It felt like something 
wonderful was about to happen...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's it! There's always that option! You 
actually have good ideas sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll cast a 'Speed Up Spell'! 'Finish in 
the blink of an eye! Alstroemeria☆'!
choice_data_list: As expected of a magical girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Amazing, right? Now then, let's 
wrap this up in no time!
choice_data_list:
(Glad to see her motivation went through 
the roof.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —A-And... I'm dooooone~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I am... seriously magical! To think I 
finished it all within today...!
choice_data_list: That spell earlier was amazing too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right, right? The effect was super potent!

Whether it was truly the power of magic... 
aside. I walked back to the dorms 
alongside a very happy Sweep.
